nodes.label: React Compiler
nodes.rationale: Not enabled on this template because of its impact on dev & build performance.

nodes.label: Vite React-TS Template
nodes.rationale: Recommended for production applications needing TypeScript with type-aware lint rules.

nodes.label: Child With Bed Count (CWB)
nodes.rationale: Age >= 5 AND Age < 12 AND Bed_Required == True.

nodes.label: Child No Bed Count (CNB)
nodes.rationale: Age >= 5 AND Age < 12 AND Bed_Required == False.

nodes.label: Hotel Room Allocation Logic
nodes.rationale: Calculates minimum rooms required and Room Configuration Tag per room to optimize costs.

nodes.label: Max Occupancy Rules Per Standard Room
nodes.rationale: Absolute max: 3 Adults OR 2 Adults + 2 Children; default base allocation 2 Adults per room.
nodes.norm_label: max occupancy rules per standard room

nodes.label: Sequential Allocation Algorithm
nodes.rationale: Conditional logic loop branching on total adults and children counts to distribute guests into rooms.

nodes.label: Per Adult Package Price
nodes.rationale: Total fixed investment is divided back down to a per-adult cost, with child costs broken out separately.

nodes.label: Vehicle Override (UI)
nodes.rationale: Dropdown allowing manual vehicle upgrade (e.g. Sedan to Innova Crysta) with real-time per-head cost recalculation.

nodes.label: Triple Sharing Override Toggle
nodes.rationale: Allows manually overriding a Triple Sharing Room into 1 Double + 1 Single if clients refuse an extra floor mattress.

nodes.label: Dynamic Guest Addition Form
nodes.rationale: Collects Name, Age, and Bed Preference (Yes/No if age is 5-11) per guest.
